rows.requirement: System nominal voltage, wiring and frequency must match the specified values
Main‑bus continuous rating must meet or exceed the scheduled bus ampere rating
Short‑time and short‑circuit current rating must match the highest‑rated circuit breaker in the assembly
Fabrication shall comply with the project specifications
Factory assembled and tested in accordance with IEEE C37.20.1
Indoor enclosure material shall be steel
Outdoor enclosure material shall be galvanized steel
Outdoor enclosure must be weatherproof, have an integral structural‑steel base frame with factory‑applied asphaltic undercoating, and include all listed compartment features
Aisle access doors must have outside padlocking provisions and interior panic latches.
Aisle space heaters must operate at one-half or less of rated voltage and be thermostatically controlled.
Vapor proof fluorescent aisle lights must use low-temperature ballasts and be controlled by a wall switch at each entrance.
A minimum of two GFCI duplex receptacles must be located in the aisle.
Aisle ventilation louvers must have insect and rodent screen and filter, arranged to permit air circulation while excluding insects, rodents, and exterior dust.
